notes.title: Update log 2023.08.25
notes.notes:
The content of this update is as follows:
1. Add viewing painting scaling and dragging function；
2. Modify the wrong words feedback from the curator；
3. Repair the painting appreciation, the suspension prompt after the mouse leaves, the problem of not disappearing；
4. Fix the painting description of the problem of using the mouse wheel to roll directly to the end；
5. Fix the problem that the first gold trophy is not accurate；
6. Fix some problems with some computer games without sound.

Some museums have no music after starting the game.
Please press the following steps to operate:
(1) Find [Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）]-[Right-click]-[Management]-[Browse local files];
(2) Return to the previous level, delete all the files in the game root directory, and return the Steam library to uninstall the game;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42619149/121dca94c83ec242c0f0fb24d0d6c6c96f0d567d.jpg
(3) Download the game and run.

Sorry to bring inconvenience to the curators, I wish you all a happy game!

notes.title: The demo trial version of the Art Reborn has been opened！Let's carnival!
notes.notes:
The demo version of the new game- Art Reborn by MuccyGames Studio has been launched at 10:00 on November 18. We cordially invite all curators to this feast of art!

-----------Carnival Contents-----------

[Duration]
November 18, 12:00– November 30, 24:00

[How to participate]
Curators can post reviews of Art Reborn on the game's page, and gifts will then be sent to the top five people based on the number of recommendations from the reviews.

[Gift]
The first 5 winners will be given an activation code for the official version of Art Reborn on steam.
If the content of the review is not related to the game or if the review is copied or forwarded to others, the review will be considered invalid and the winner will be disqualified and the award will be deferred to the next person.
